sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a favorable fixture on paper, as Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and arrive winless in their last five games. Sandbach will be looking to extend their excellent form and maintain their one-point lead over second-placed Stafford Town.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in what shapes as a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals face a promising test away at Wednesfield Community, with both teams carrying recent form—Casuals have won their last game while Wednesfield showed resilience with a recent victory. Bilston Town, currently sixth, host struggling Foley Meir on home turf. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills in a clash between two teams in the lower half searching for consistency. Brereton Social welcome already-relegated Widnes Town (2 points), while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's poorest-performing sides. Shawbury United, on an extended run without a win, host Barnton; and Crewe face a difficult assignment away at Allscott Heath as they search for form.
